name: stop_midtask_wlroots
about: The user stops a desktop task as its first action begins, as the tray's Stop Jarvis does (the agent's control socket): no action lands after the stop, the note is never saved, and the indicator clears. The same under headless sway (Xwayland). Task 7 of PLAN-computer-use.md.
say: In the Jarvis Test Notes app, make a new note titled Groceries with milk, eggs and bread in it, and save it.
